correctness.rationale: The channel definition is reconstructed exactly. A code is a clique in the complete compatibility graph on all 64 words; deterministic Bron--Kerbosch enumeration with a sound upper-bound prune finds maximum 16 and exactly four maximum cliques. The packaged four cliques are then checked directly for pairwise disjoint error balls, and their linear/complement properties are recomputed from set closure.

value.rationale: The literature treats length-specific single-grain optima as benchmark data and emphasizes algebraic/group constructions. At a parameter where the optimum size is known, a complete extremizer census is a natural next invariant: the surprising collapse to only four labeled maxima, with exactly one linear maximum, measures how representative algebraic constructions are. This is a complete natural classification rather than an arbitrary slice or a recomputation of the known size.
